probe: ExpA — is the R24 P2 radix-ON L4096 recall@2048 breach (-0.849pp) sampling noise?
envelope: TP8 / fp8_e4m3 / page64 / mem0.8 / max-running 64 / cuda-graph-max-bs 64 / EAGER (--disable-cuda-graph) (expandable_segments NEVER set)
reuse_note: Reuses R24 harness verbatim: r24_env.sh op-point + niah_oracle_sweep.py + the SAME recall@2048 extraction as p2_recall_compare.py. No new production code.
seed_semantics: The NIAH sweep has NO --seed knob; prompts are deterministic in (length, idx) with prompt-seed 1000+idx, so the TRIAL SET is identical across all boots. The four 'distinct seeds' (20260607..20260610) are the server --random-seed; off vs on are paired within each seed on the IDENTICAL trial set.
design: For seed S in {20260607,20260608,20260609,20260610}: boot DS EAGER recall_oracle, radix-OFF (--disable-radix-cache), run NIAH sweep L4096+L16384 num=20 decode-steps=4; teardown; boot radix-ON (SGLANG_DS_RADIX_OVERRIDE=1) run SAME sweep; teardown.
Higher-n: L4096 num=80 seed 20260607, radix-OFF then radix-ON.
Aggregate per-seed off/on recall@2048 per length; paired (off-on) delta pp; cross-seed mean/min/max/std; higher-n point estimate.
expandable_segments NEVER set (unset PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF). One TP=8 server at a time; teardown to ~0 MiB between every boot.
working_tree_note: git HEAD prints f82ec2c5d but the working tree carries the UNCOMMITTED dec9 score_capture instrument (config.py +15, selection_kernel.py +31, deepseek_v2.py +3, all ADDITIVE, gated behind score_capture=False). ExpA used recall_oracle=true and did NOT enable score_capture, so the recall_oracle path is the committed-HEAD logic — confirmed by radix-OFF L4096 reproducing R24 P2 exactly (58.045%).
boot_command_off: python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <GLM> --tp-size 8 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --page-size 64 --dsa-prefill-backend flashmla_kv --dsa-decode-backend flashmla_kv --disable-overlap-schedule --disable-piecewise-cuda-graph --random-seed <S> --trust-remote-code --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --max-running-requests 64 --cuda-graph-max-bs 64 --enable-double-sparsity --double-sparsity-config '<DS_CFG recall_oracle:true>' --disable-cuda-graph --disable-radix-cache
boot_command_on: SGLANG_DS_RADIX_OVERRIDE=1 python -m sglang.launch_server <same as off, WITHOUT --disable-radix-cache>
